To address the challenges in manual attendance processes, this research explores the use of face detection (FD) and face recognition (FR) technology to automate the attendance process, particularly in educational settings, and build a ClassVision course attendance system. We also propose an automated attendance system featuring a human-computer interaction (HCI) and user-friendly web interface that utilizes real-time image processing to identify and recognize students in classrooms and automatically record their attendance. We identified RetinaFace as the best face detection model, and when combined with Face Recognition for verification, it provided the most promising results with a cropped embedding of 50x50 pixels.
summary_zh: 学生与职场从业者每天都需要完成考勤流程，传统纸笔签到或线上平台考勤方法人力成本高、耗时长。为解决人工考勤流程的痛点，本研究探索将人脸检测（Face Detection, FD）与人脸识别（Face Recognition, FR）技术应用于教育场景下的考勤自动化流程，搭建ClassVision课程考勤系统。该系统搭载人机交互（Human-Computer Interaction, HCI）模块与易用的网页界面，利用实时图像处理技术识别课堂内的学生并自动记录考勤。研究验证得到RetinaFace为最优人脸检测模型，将其与人脸识别校验模块结合，使用50×50像素的裁剪嵌入特征时可获得最优效果。

title: CARE: Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration for Medical Large Language Models
title_zh: CARE：面向医疗大语言模型的因果对齐推理探索框架
authors: Yucheng Zhou, Peng Luo, Qianning Wang, Chengzhong Xu, Jianbing Shen
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for medical reasoning, yet the scarcity and cost of expert-annotated data constrain their progress. While reinforcement learning offers a scalable alternative, standard outcome-based methods in medicine often suffer from autoregressive credit assignment failure and gradient variance explosion. This leads to the "Right Answer, Wrong Reason" trap, where models inadvertently reinforce spurious correlations and dataset shortcuts rather than valid clinical deduction. In this work, we propose Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration (CARE), a theoretically grounded framework for intrinsic experience curation. CARE is built upon two rigorous conditions for high-quality training trajectories: Causal Sufficiency, which utilizes an agreement-based self-verification mechanism to mimic $do$-calculus interventions and effectively debias gradients; and Proximal Learnability, which employs dynamic entropy bounds to select experiences within the model's zone of proximal development for variance-bounded optimization. These rigorously filtered experiences are optimized via a dual-stream objective that combines on-policy group-relative exploration with difficulty-weighted experience replay. Extensive experiments on diverse medical multimodal and text-only benchmarks demonstrate that CARE consistently outperforms other strong competitors, substantially reducing correct-but-inconsistent reasoning and improving training stability.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）在医疗推理领域展现出巨大潜力，但专家标注数据的稀缺性与高成本限制了其发展。强化学习提供了可扩展的替代方案，但医疗领域传统的基于结果的强化学习方法普遍存在自回归信用分配失效与梯度方差爆炸问题，容易陷入“答案正确、推理错误”的陷阱：模型会无意识地强化虚假关联与数据集捷径，而非学习有效的临床推演逻辑。本文提出因果对齐推理探索（Causally-Aligned Reasoning Exploration, CARE）框架，是具备理论支撑的内在经验筛选框架。CARE基于高质量训练轨迹的两项严格约束构建：一是因果充分性，利用基于一致性的自校验机制模拟do演算干预，有效降低梯度偏差；二是近端可学习性，采用动态熵边界筛选处于模型最近发展区内的经验，实现方差有界的优化。经过严格筛选的经验通过双流目标函数优化，融合同策略组相对探索与难度加权经验回放机制。在多类医疗多模态与纯文本基准测试集上的大量实验表明，CARE的性能始终优于其他对比方法，可大幅降低答案正确但推理逻辑不一致的问题，提升训练稳定性。

title: FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference
title_zh: FlashVLA：面向快速异步视觉-语言-动作推理的流式动作解码框架
authors: Zekai Li, Jiaming Tang, Zhijian Liu
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly promising for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment remains bottlenecked by high inference latency and unstable asynchronous execution. This challenge is particularly pronounced in flow-matching-based VLA models, where action decoding requires multiple iterative steps conditioned on the VLM context. While efficient inference methods improve control frequency and asynchronous methods reduce execution idle time, existing approaches often fail to jointly achieve low-latency inference and accurate, temporally consistent asynchronous execution. We introduce \textbf{FlashVLA}, a streaming action decoding framework that addresses both challenges in a unified formulation. FlashVLA maintains a streaming action buffer with multiple chunks at different noise levels and decodes them using chunk-wise causal attention. This design allows FlashVLA to produce one executable action chunk per inference step. Moreover, its chunk-wise autoregressive formulation implicitly preserves action continuity, enabling smooth asynchronous execution without extra future-state conditioning. Across extensive simulated and real-world experiments, FlashVLA substantially improves inference speed while maintaining strong task performance. It can achieve $\geq$30\,Hz control frequency on a single GPU with smooth asynchronous inference in real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型在机器人操控场景中展现出广阔应用前景，但高推理延迟与不稳定的异步执行问题始终制约其实际落地，该问题在基于流匹配的VLA模型中尤为突出：这类模型的动作解码需要在视觉语言模型（VLM）上下文条件下完成多轮迭代步骤。尽管现有高效推理方法可提升控制频率，异步方法可降低执行空闲时间，但现有方案无法同时实现低延迟推理与高精度、时序一致的异步执行。本文提出FlashVLA流式动作解码框架，在统一范式下同时解决上述两类问题。FlashVLA维护包含多个不同噪声水平块的流式动作缓冲区，采用逐块因果注意力完成解码，该设计使得每步推理即可生成一个可执行动作块。此外其逐块自回归范式可隐式保留动作连续性，无需额外未来状态条件即可实现流畅的异步执行。大量仿真与真实场景实验表明，FlashVLA在保持优异任务性能的同时可大幅提升推理速度，在单张GPU上即可实现≥30Hz的控制频率，在实际部署场景下可完成流畅的异步推理。

title: Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning
title_zh: 具身场景重排列规划
authors: Canzhi Chen, Zan Wang, Siqi Zhu, Qi Wu, Yixuan Li 等 (6 人)
abstract: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a novel task requiring embodied agents to rearrange furniture in 3D scenes to match a target configuration using only egocentric observations and a top-down target layout. Unlike prior rearrangement tasks, ESRP precludes global state access and introduces mutual object occlusions, reflecting the practical constraints of real-world robotic deployment. These factors make aligning partial egocentric observations with the global target layout particularly challenging for long-horizon planning. To facilitate research, we present ESRP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built on OmniGibson featuring over 5,400 scene pairs and 8,200 objects. We define three multi-level metrics to evaluate rearrangement quality and provide four baselines: a hierarchical task-and-motion planning method, a vision-language-model-based method, and two learning-based approaches (IL and RL). Experimental results demonstrate that current methods struggle to complete the task efficiently, highlighting ESRP as a challenging frontier for embodied agents in scene understanding and long-horizon task planning. This work serves as a stepping stone toward deploying intelligent agents in real-world scenarios. Project page:this https URL.
summary_zh: 本文提出具身场景重排列规划（Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning, ESRP）这一全新任务：要求具身智能体仅利用第一人称观测与俯视目标布局，对3D场景内的家具进行重排列，使其匹配目标配置。与传统重排列任务不同，ESRP不允许智能体访问全局状态，同时引入物体间互遮挡约束，更贴近真实机器人部署的实际限制，这些特性使得长周期规划任务中部分第一人称观测与全局目标布局的对齐难度大幅提升。为推动相关领域研究，本文构建了基于OmniGibson的综合基准测试集ESRP-Bench，包含超过5400组场景对与8200个物体。本文定义了三级多维度指标用于评估重排列质量，同时提供四类基线方法：分层任务与运动规划方法、基于视觉语言模型的方法、两类基于学习的方法（模仿学习IL与强化学习RL）。实验结果表明现有方法难以高效完成该任务，说明ESRP是具身智能体在场景理解与长周期任务规划领域极具挑战性的前沿方向，可为真实场景下智能体的落地应用提供支撑。项目主页可访问提供的对应URL。

title: Marine Autonomous Vehicle Fleet Scheduling to Maximise Scientific Impact
title_zh: 最大化科学效益的海洋自主航行器编队调度
authors: Mehdi El Krari, Jonathan Smith, Maria Fox
abstract: The marine science community increasingly relies on Marine Autonomous Vehicles (MAVs) to collect the critical environmental data required to understand global ocean systems. However, as these operations scale, manually routing and planning large autonomous fleets becomes exponentially complex and time-consuming. To address this, we propose a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model designed to automate and optimise MAV deployment schedules. The model accounts for strict operational constraints, including battery capacities and time windows for data collection, while aiming to maximise total data collection and minimise both the number of deployed vehicles and their energy consumption. A key novelty of this framework is integrating conventional ship itineraries, allowing MAVs to support vessels with mid-mission battery swapping or accelerated transit between waypoints. Computational experiments demonstrate that the model is highly scalable, solving routing problems for fleets of dozens of MAVs in seconds, and scaling to hundreds of vehicles in only a few minutes. Beyond operational scheduling, the framework serves as a robust simulation tool for evaluating 'what-if' scenarios and analysing the impact of varying parameters on deployment strategies. Finally, the solution generates a suite of visualisations designed to enhance explainability and support strategic decision-making for stakeholders.
summary_zh: 海洋科学领域越来越依赖海洋自主航行器（Marine Autonomous Vehicles, MAVs）采集关键环境数据，支撑全球海洋系统研究。但随着作业规模扩大，人工完成大型自主编队的路径规划与调度工作复杂度呈指数级上升，耗时极长。针对该问题，本文提出混合整数线性规划（Mixed-Integer Linear Programming, MILP）模型，用于自动化优化MAV部署调度方案。该模型在满足电池容量、数据采集时间窗口等严格作业约束的前提下，最大化总数据采集量，同时最小化部署航行器数量与总能耗。该框架的核心创新点是融合了常规船舶航行路线，支持MAV在任务中途依托船舶完成电池更换，或在途经点之间实现加速转场。计算实验表明该模型具备极高的可扩展性，可在数秒内完成数十台MAV编队的路径规划问题，仅需数分钟即可处理上百台航行器的调度任务。除作业调度外，该框架还可作为可靠的仿真工具，用于评估各类假设场景、分析不同参数对部署策略的影响。最终生成的多类可视化结果可提升方案可解释性，为相关决策者提供战略层面的支撑。

title: STEP: State-Aware Task Estimation and Planning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Human-Robot Collaboration
title_zh: STEP：面向人机协作的多模态大语言模型状态感知任务估计与规划框架
authors: Maitrey Gramopadhye, Prakash Baskaran, Xiao Liu, Songpo Li, Soshi Iba
abstract: Effective human-robot collaboration in industrial settings requires robots to understand human intentions and assist with task planning, reducing workload. Recent works have explored the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) for task planning in such data-scarce scenarios, leveraging in-context learning to interpret user actions and generate long-horizon action plans in natural language. However, MM-LLMs inherently lack an understanding of system states and do not track state transitions, often leading to hallucinated actions that deviate from the intended goal. Additionally, generating action plans in natural language tends to limit the generated plans to a high level, introducing ambiguity in action execution. To address these limitations, we propose the State-aware Task Estimator and Planner (STEP), which prompts a MM-LLM to explicitly estimate the state of the system and predict the state transitions resulting from executed actions. By forecasting future states alongside actions, STEP ensures task-convergent planning while also providing additional assistance parameters necessary for executing the predicted actions. We evaluate STEP in a simulated environment using a robot assembly task. Our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art by 32.8% in action executability and 14.8% in final-state error.
summary_zh: 工业场景下高效的人机协作要求机器人理解人类意图、辅助完成任务规划以降低人力负担。近期相关研究探索将多模态大语言模型（Multi-modal Large Language Models, MM-LLMs）应用于这类数据稀缺场景的任务规划，利用上下文学习能力解读用户动作，生成自然语言形式的长周期动作规划。但MM-LLMs本身缺乏对系统状态的认知，无法跟踪状态转移过程，经常生成偏离预期目标的幻觉动作。此外，自然语言形式的动作规划通常粒度较粗，容易在动作执行阶段引入歧义。针对上述缺陷，本文提出状态感知任务估计与规划框架（State-aware Task Estimation and Planner, STEP），通过提示工程引导MM-LLM显式估计系统状态，预测执行动作带来的状态转移。通过同时预测未来状态与动作，STEP可保证规划方向始终向任务目标收敛，同时提供执行预测动作所需的额外辅助参数。本文在仿真环境下通过机器人装配任务对STEP进行评估，结果表明该方法在动作可执行性指标上比现有最优方法高出32.8%，最终状态误差降低14.8%。

title: Tensegrity Continuum Robots Enable Task-Adaptive Morphologies for Cooperative Behaviors
title_zh: 张拉整体连续体机器人可实现适配任务形态的协同行为
authors: Mahmud Hasan Saikot, Sydney Spiegel, Sudheera Akalanka Kariyawasam, Andrew Stefka, Josh Chrisler 等 (6 人)
abstract: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we introduce an MRR that unifies the advantages of both architectures by combining a tensegrity-based compliant body with claw-based connection mechanisms. Each robot can manipulate and locomote independently, and multiple robots can self-reconfigure into different morphologies (e.g., chains, loops, branches) for cooperative manipulation and locomotion. We demonstrate the robots' capability across diverse tasks and environments, including coordinated object manipulation and transport, multimodal locomotion, and loco-manipulation in real-world scenarios. These results lay a foundation for adaptable and multifunctional robotic collectives, with broad potential applications in manufacturing, space exploration, and search-and-rescue operations.
summary_zh: 可针对不同任务与环境调整自身形态与行为的机器人，是高适应性多功能系统的重要发展方向。模块化可重构机器人（Modular Reconfigurable Robots, MRRs）可通过对接与重组独立单元实现上述功能，但现有多数方案采用刚性模块，缺乏结构柔顺性，能力受限。连续体机器人依托柔性骨架实现柔顺特性，但无法自重构为适配任务的多机器人配置。本文提出一类融合两类架构优势的MRR，将基于张拉整体的柔顺本体与爪式连接机构相结合。单台机器人可独立完成操控与移动任务，多台机器人可自重构为链状、环状、分支状等不同形态，实现协同操控与协同移动。本文在多类任务与环境下验证了该机器人的性能，包括协同物体操控与运输、多模态移动、真实场景下的移动-操控一体化作业。研究结果为高适应性多功能机器人群体的发展奠定了基础，在制造业、太空探索、搜救等领域具备广阔应用前景。

title: Task-space model-based control of pneumatic soft actuators
title_zh: 基于任务空间模型的气动软执行器控制
authors: Nithin S. Kumar, Joshua Gaston, D. Caleb Rucker, Eric J. Barth
abstract: Soft actuators enable dexterous and compliant interaction, but closed-loop task-space control remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities, distributed deformation, and uncertainty in their dynamics. This paper presents a real-time dynamic-model-based task-space feedback and estimation framework based on a non-minimal coordinate discrete elastic rod model formulated in absolute coordinates with holonomic constraints. The resulting structure preserves distributed mechanics while maintaining computational efficiency through sparse system matrices, enabling real-time control with up to 10 discretized rods. A quasi-static feedforward inverse model is combined with a task-space PI controller and a dynamic observer that fuses measurement residuals as virtual forces, enabling full-state estimation from sparse sensing. The approach is experimentally validated on three planar pneumatic soft actuators with varying geometries. Across five tasks, including drawing the digits 0-9 across the workspace (3-18 mm/s tip speed), tracking periodic motion (up to 37 cm/s), cross-platform generalization, reduced sensing conditions, and real-time user-defined references, our method achieves 1.5-2.3 mm root mean square error (RMSE) for precision motions and 5.5-12.4 mm RMSE at 1-2 Hz. Results demonstrate that structured, non-minimal dynamic models can enable real-time, high-precision, moderate-bandwidth task-space control of planar soft pneumatic actuators in free space.
summary_zh: 软执行器可实现高灵活性、高柔顺性交互，但由于其动力学存在强非线性、分布形变与不确定性，闭环任务空间控制始终是领域难点。本文提出基于实时动力学模型的任务空间反馈与估计框架，采用绝对坐标下构建的带完整约束的非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型。该结构在保留分布力学特性的同时，依托稀疏系统矩阵保证计算效率，支持最多10个离散杆的实时控制。框架将准静态前馈逆模型与任务空间PI控制器、动态观测器相结合，动态观测器可融合测量残差作为虚拟力，基于稀疏传感实现全状态估计。本文通过三类不同几何构型的平面气动软执行器对该方法开展实验验证，覆盖五类任务场景：工作空间内绘制数字0-9（末端速度3-18mm/s）、周期运动跟踪（最高37cm/s）、跨平台泛化、低传感条件、实时用户自定义参考轨迹。所提方法在精密运动场景下的均方根误差（Root Mean Square Error, RMSE）为1.5-2.3mm，在1-2Hz运动场景下的RMSE为5.5-12.4mm。结果表明，结构化非最小动力学模型可实现自由空间内平面气动软执行器的实时、高精度、中等带宽任务空间控制。

title: Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages
title_zh: 面向机器人多拆卸阶段的共享模块化夹具布局规划
authors: Haohui Pan, Takuya Kiyokawa, Kensuke Harada
abstract: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products. As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the complete disassembly sequence of a screwdriver or shaver, allowing each sequence to proceed without fixture reconfiguration. To search the mixed continuous--discrete layout space under repeated cross-stage evaluation, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model generates physics-informed initial configurations that are refined through Bayesian optimization. Robotic screw and component-removal experiments verified the disassembly feasibility of the planned layouts, while 11 directional-load tests quantified their stability. Comparisons between the measured operational loads and directional responses yielded mean empirical stability margins of 66.9% for the screwdriver and 81.6% for the shaver. These results demonstrate that a product-specific shared layout can provide stable support throughout the tested robotic disassembly sequence.
summary_zh: 不规则形状产品的机器人拆卸作业中，稳定支撑始终是一大挑战。随着零部件被逐步移除，整个拆卸过程中可用支撑面、质量分布与任务负载都会发生变化。因此，为某一工件状态设计的夹具布局在后续拆卸阶段可能不再适用，这就需要针对完整拆卸序列开展统一支撑规划。本文提出一种基于模块化真空的夹具系统，可为螺丝刀或剃须刀的完整拆卸序列规划单一共享支撑构型，使整个拆卸流程无需对夹具进行重新配置即可完成。为在反复跨阶段评估下搜索连续-离散混合布局空间，该系统采用去噪扩散概率模型生成符合物理规律的初始构型，再通过贝叶斯优化完成构型优化。机器人拧螺丝与零部件移除实验验证了所规划布局的拆卸可行性，11项定向负载测试则量化了布局的稳定性。实测运行负载与定向响应的对比结果显示，螺丝刀拆卸场景的平均经验稳定裕度为66.9%，剃须刀场景为81.6%。上述结果表明，针对特定产品设计的共享布局可在整个被测机器人拆卸序列中提供稳定支撑。

title: Active sensing to characterize the heterogeneity of plant stress
title_zh: 面向植物胁迫异质性表征的主动感知技术
authors: Ayman Laaroussi, Peter Hanappe, David Colliaux
abstract: While most phenotyping platforms rely primarily on image-based measurements, advanced plant characterization requires the integration of active physiological sensing modali- ties such as chlorophyll fluorescence. We present an autonomous robotic platform designed to perform targeted fluorescence measurements on plant leaves. The system combines 3D plant reconstruction, geometric analysis, and motion planning to localize suitable measurement points and generate collision-free trajectories for a robotic manipulator.A dense 3D model of the plant is reconstructed from multi-view data and used to extract candidate leaf surfaces based on orientation, accessibility, and sensing constraints. These targets are then integrated into a task-level planning framework that guides the end-effector to precise contact or near-contact configurations required for point-based fluorescence acquisition. The platform enables automated, repeatable, and spatially resolved physiological measurements that go beyond passive imaging. By tightly coupling perception, geometric reasoning, and manipulation, the proposed system provides a robotics-driven approach to high-resolution plant phenotyping and opens new directions for autonomous agricultural inspection and plant-aware manipulation.
summary_zh: 当前大多数植物表型平台主要依赖基于图像的测量手段，而先进的植物表征工作需要整合叶绿素荧光等主动生理感知模态。本文提出一款自主机器人平台，可针对植物叶片开展靶向荧光测量。该系统融合三维植物重建、几何分析与运动规划技术，可定位合适的测量点，并为机械臂生成无碰撞轨迹。系统从多视角数据重建得到植物的稠密三维模型，基于朝向、可访问性与感知约束提取候选叶片表面，再将这些目标点接入任务级规划框架，引导末端执行器到达基于点的荧光采集所需的精确接触或近接触位姿。该平台可实现自动化、可重复、空间分辨率明确的生理测量，性能远超被动成像方案。通过将感知、几何推理与机械操作深度耦合，所提系统提供了机器人驱动的高分辨率植物表型新路径，为自主农业巡检与植物感知型操作开辟了新方向。

title: Pass the Bucket: Efficient, Robust, Local Load Balancing for Teams of Heterogeneous Robots
title_zh: 传递桶：面向异质机器人集群的高效鲁棒局部负载均衡方法
authors: Tobias Wallner, Dominik Krupke, Arne Schmidt, Sándor P. Fekete
abstract: We study the problem of decentralized, self-organized task sharing for a swarm of heterogeneous robots that collaborate in transportation or other objectives that require coordinated motion planning. To this end, we present theoretical and practical results for the simple but effective mechanism of \emph{bucket brigades} for load balancing, in which a team of heterogenous robots share a spatial task in a confined, one-dimensional space, while only being able to sense collisions with neighbors or walls. The goal is to optimize throughput of the overall system, without central control or information, aiming at an interval partition proportional to robot velocities. We address possible chaotic system behavior by developing a stabilization mechanism based on simple local aid, a ``token'', that temporarily decelerates robots after an encounter. This purely local change eliminates persistent oscillations, resulting in convergence towards a stable system state. We accelerate system convergence by comparing a single boundary token to ubiquitous two-directional tokens and optimizing the deceleration factor. Event-driven simulations report convergence times and robustness: For a large variety of perturbations (such as robot deletion, position or velocity jittering), the system reliably re-converges. The results suggest a local, practical mechanism for robust load balancing for heterogeneous teams of robots that promises an effective tool as basis for more complex scenarios.
summary_zh: 本文研究面向运输或其他需要协同运动规划任务的异质机器人集群，实现去中心化自组织任务共享的问题。为此，本文针对简单但效果优异的桶队（bucket brigades）负载均衡机制给出理论与实践结果：异质机器人团队在受限一维空间内共享空间任务，仅能感知与相邻机器人或墙壁的碰撞，目标是在无中央控制、无需全局信息的前提下优化系统整体吞吐量，实现与机器人速度成比例的区间划分。本文提出基于简单局部辅助标识“令牌”的稳定机制，机器人在相遇后会临时减速，以此消除系统可能出现的混沌行为。这种纯局部调整可消除持续振荡，使系统收敛到稳定状态。本文对比了单一边界令牌与通用双向令牌的效果，优化减速系数以加快系统收敛速度。事件驱动仿真给出了收敛时间与鲁棒性表现：在各类扰动场景下（如机器人退出、位置或速度抖动），系统均可可靠地重新收敛。结果表明，该局部实用机制可实现异质机器人团队的鲁棒负载均衡，可作为复杂场景下的有效基础工具。

title: GRAFT: Grounded and Efficient Online Reinforcement Adaptation for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
title_zh: GRAFT：面向细粒度机器人操作的锚定高效在线强化自适应框架
authors: Yibo Qiu, Haoliang Ye, Shu'ang Sun, Zan Huang, Ronald X Xu 等 (6 人)
abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them online to fine-grained biomedical tasks remains challenging. Task success often hinges on subtle, view-dependent visual cues, while task-level rewards provide little guidance about which regions matter, making it difficult to learn task-relevant visual grounding from limited real-robot interaction. Online adaptation is further constrained by the computational cost of VLA inference and replay-based updates. We introduce GRAFT (Grounded Reinforcement Adaptation for Fast Task Learning), a framework for efficient online VLA adaptation through grounded perception. GRAFT uses region-level supervision to learn view-specific visual anchors that focus perception on task-relevant local cues without requiring region proposals at deployment. It further combines single-step action generation with cached visual-language prefix reuse to accelerate online learning. Across four biomedical manipulation tasks, GRAFT improves success rates by 25 percentage points under matched adaptation budgets, while reducing the computational overhead of online policy updates.
summary_zh: 预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可为机器人操作提供强先验，但将其在线适配到细粒度生物医学任务仍存在较大挑战。任务成功往往取决于细微的、随视角变化的视觉线索，而任务级奖励几乎无法指示哪些区域是关键区域，导致难以从有限的真实机器人交互中学习到与任务相关的视觉锚定能力。VLA推理与基于回放的更新带来的计算开销进一步限制了在线自适应性能。本文提出GRAFT（面向快速任务学习的锚定强化自适应框架），通过锚定感知实现高效的VLA在线自适应。GRAFT利用区域级监督学习视角特定的视觉锚点，将感知聚焦在与任务相关的局部线索上，部署阶段无需生成区域候选。该框架进一步将单步动作生成与缓存的视觉-语言前缀复用相结合，加快在线学习速度。在4项生物医学操作任务上的实验结果表明，在相同自适应预算下，GRAFT可将任务成功率提升25个百分点，同时降低在线策略更新的计算开销。

title: Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI
title_zh: Riemann-1.0：面向物理人工智能的具身世界动作模型
authors: Haofeng Sun, Jiangbo Pei, Fei Kang, Zexiang Liu, Yaokun Li 等 (16 人)
abstract: We introduce Riemann-1.0, a fully causal autoregressive World Action Model for embodied intelligence. Riemann-1.0 jointly models multi-view visual observations, robot states, and embodiment-specific actions within a unified causal autoregressive sequence, representing robot actions and world evolution as causal state transitions. Unlike existing WAMs based on joint generation, video-first prediction, or decoupled modeling paradigms, Riemann-1.0 unifies online robot policy execution and action-conditioned world simulation within a single model, enabling it to function as both an executable robot policy and a multi-embodiment visual world simulator. To scale embodied experience across heterogeneous data sources, we further develop a progressive embodied pretraining framework that unifies learning from egocentric human videos, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and heterogeneous robot trajectories under a shared World Action Modeling objective. Built upon 200K+ hours of interaction data, Riemann-1.0 progressively transfers large-scale embodied experience into executable robot manipulation capabilities. Riemann-1.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. It achieves success rates of 94.3% on RoboTwin2.0, 99.0% on LIBERO, and 62.6% on the long-horizon compositional benchmark RoboCasa-365, outperforming the previous best method by 8.4% On long-horizon real-world manipulation tasks, Riemann-1.0 achieves a Success Rate (SR) of 85.0% and a Progress Success Rate (PSR) of 94.4%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 15% in SR. These results demonstrate that unified World Action Modeling together with progressive embodied pretraining effectively transforms large-scale embodied experience into generalizable robot manipulation capabilities.
summary_zh: 本文提出Riemann-1.0，一款面向具身智能的完全因果自回归世界动作模型。Riemann-1.0在统一的因果自回归序列中联合建模多视角视觉观测、机器人状态与具身专属动作，将机器人动作与世界演化表示为因果状态转移。不同于现有基于联合生成、视频优先预测或解耦建模范式的世界动作模型，Riemann-1.0将在线机器人策略执行与动作条件化世界仿真统一到单个模型中，使其既可作为可执行机器人策略，也可作为多具身视觉世界模拟器。为实现跨异构数据源的具身经验规模化，本文进一步提出渐进式具身预训练框架，在统一的世界动作建模目标下，整合从第一人称人类视频、手持夹爪演示、异构机器人轨迹中的学习过程。基于超过20万小时的交互数据，Riemann-1.0将大规模具身经验逐步转化为可执行的机器人操作能力。Riemann-1.0在仿真基准与真实世界操作任务上均取得了当前最优性能：在RoboTwin2.0上成功率达94.3%，在LIBERO上达99.0%，在长时序组合基准RoboCasa-365上达62.6%，相比此前最优方法性能提升8.4%；在长时序真实世界操作任务中，Riemann-1.0的成功率（SR）达85.0%，进度成功率（PSR）达94.4%，相比最强开源基线的SR指标高出15%。上述结果表明，统一的世界动作建模结合渐进式具身预训练，可有效将大规模具身经验转化为泛化性机器人操作能力。

title: Arbitrary-Order Hermite Interpolation of Rigid-Motion Jets via Hyper-Multidual Quaternions
title_zh: 基于超多对偶四元数的刚体运动喷流任意阶Hermite插值
authors: Daniel Condurache
abstract: We study bilateral interpolation of finite-order rigid-motion jets represented by unit dual quaternions. An order-$n$ multidual (MD) algebra is the truncated polynomial algebra $\mathbb{R}[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^{n+1})$; hyper-multidual (HMD) quaternions are dual quaternions with coefficients in this algebra. Temporal HMD transforms encode a pose and its derivatives, whereas a generic HMD curve need not be the temporal jet of its pose projection; we call this requirement holonomicity. We show that a temporal transform and its relative descriptor are unitary and derive recursive coefficient constraints, together with a local realizability converse in an admissible logarithm chart. We then extend screw linear interpolation (ScLERP) algebraically to unit HMD quaternions. Although it matches complete endpoint transforms, direct HMD--ScLERP is generically non-holonomic for arbitrary endpoint jets. We give a coefficient criterion and explicit endpoint and first-order interior contact defects. A holonomic alternative is obtained by mapping endpoint transforms to logarithmic dual-quaternion coordinates, applying the degree-$(2n+1)$ Hermite polynomial that matches derivatives through order $n$, and lifting by the exponential. HMD arithmetic also recovers higher-order rigid-motion acceleration fields without explicit differentiation of $\mathrm{dexp}$. Rotation and full $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ tests through second order, with an additional third-order polynomial check, reproduce the stated defects and endpoint jets.
summary_zh: 本文研究由单位对偶四元数表示的有限阶刚体运动喷流的双向插值问题。n阶多对偶（MD）代数是截断多项式代数ℝ[ε]/(ε^(n+1))；超多对偶（HMD）四元数是系数定义在该代数上的对偶四元数。时域HMD变换可编码位姿及其各阶导数，而通用HMD曲线不一定是其位姿投影的时域喷流，本文将该约束条件称为完整性。本文证明时域变换及其相对描述符是酉的，推导得到递归系数约束，并在容许对数图中给出局部可实现性的逆定理。随后本文将螺旋线性插值（ScLERP）代数扩展到单位HMD四元数场景，尽管直接HMD-ScLERP可匹配完整的端点变换，但对于任意端点喷流，该方法通常不满足完整性。本文给出了系数判别准则，以及显式的端点与一阶内部接触缺陷。本文通过将端点变换映射到对数对偶四元数坐标，应用可匹配所有n阶及以下导数的2n+1次Hermite多项式，再通过指数映射升维，得到满足完整性的替代方案。HMD算术无需对dexp做显式微分即可恢复高阶刚体运动加速度场。针对二阶旋转与完整SE(3)场景的测试，以及额外的三阶多项式校验，均复现了文中所述的缺陷与端点喷流特性。

title: Dynamic Haven Selection for Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Constrained Warehouses
title_zh: 面向受限仓库场景多智能体取放任务的动态安全区选择方法
authors: Taisei Hirayama, Kohei Yoshida, Hiroki Sakaji, Itsuki Noda
abstract: Space-efficient warehouse layouts often contain single-agent-width aisles and dead-end workstations where robots have few places to wait without blocking others. In Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD) on such constrained layouts, robots must accept online pickup-delivery tasks while preserving protected waiting locations called Havens. The Safe HAven Retreat Planner (SHARP) introduced a mechanism that extends each committed task path with a validated retreat to the agent's dedicated initial Haven, but fixed-Haven commitments can send agents toward distant Havens after deliveries. We present A-sharp (Adaptive SHARP), which changes an agent's retreat target at task assignment time. A naive switch can cause two agents to rely on the same waiting location or let another committed path pass through a location that is still occupied or reserved. A-sharp prevents these failures with an availability test for candidate Havens and a pending-release rule that keeps the previous Haven protected until the agent departs. Under explicit Haven-structure and Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) assumptions, we prove invariant preservation and finite-release completeness: every task in any finite release sequence is delivered in finite time. Across 72,000 runs on 14,400 paired map-agent-count-rate-seed cases over four maps, both SHARP and A-sharp complete their respective 14,400 runs. For makespan (final delivery time), a prespecified paired comparison with Holm correction over all 138 configurations with more Havens than agents finds A-sharp significantly better in 107 configurations and never significantly worse than SHARP; on the tested tree map, the median reduction is 16.7%.
summary_zh: 空间高效的仓库布局通常包含仅容单机器人通行的通道与死端工作站，机器人几乎没有可等待的空位而不阻塞其他机器人。在这类受限布局下的多智能体取放（MAPD）任务中，机器人需要承接在线取放任务，同时保留名为“安全区（Haven）”的受保护等待位置。现有安全区撤退规划器（SHARP）提出了一种机制，为每个已提交的任务路径扩展经过验证的撤退路线，指向智能体专属的初始安全区，但固定安全区的约束会导致机器人在完成配送后向远处的安全区移动。本文提出A-sharp（自适应SHARP）方法，在任务分配阶段即可更改智能体的撤退目标。简单的切换策略可能导致两个智能体依赖同一等待位置，或其他已提交路径穿过仍被占用或预留的位置。A-sharp通过对候选安全区开展可用性测试，以及设置待释放规则，在智能体离开前保持原有安全区处于受保护状态，避免上述故障。在明确的安全区结构与安全区间路径规划（SIPP）假设下，本文证明了不变量保留特性与有限释放完备性：任意有限任务发布序列中的所有任务都可在有限时间内完成配送。在4张地图上开展的72000次测试覆盖14400组配对的地图-智能体数量-任务速率-随机种子场景，SHARP与A-sharp均完成了全部14400组测试。针对最大完工时间（最后一个任务的配送时间）指标，在安全区数量大于智能体数量的138种配置下开展带Holm校正的预设配对对比，结果显示A-sharp在107种配置下显著优于SHARP，且从未出现性能显著差于SHARP的情况；在测试的树状地图上，A-sharp的最大完工时间中位数降低了16.7%。

title: Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization for Underwater Sampling
title_zh: 面向水下采样任务的接触辅助因子图定位方法
authors: Michele Grimaldi, Yosaku Maeda, Hitoshi Kakami, Ignacio Carlucho, Yvan R. Petillot 等 (6 人)
abstract: Accurate state estimation for autonomous underwater vehicles performing close-range seafloor sampling remains challenging. In low-altitude operation, down-looking cameras over featureless planar seabeds produce scale ambiguity, lateral degeneracy, and inconsistent feature tracking. Meanwhile, inertial-Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) fusion alone provides no mechanism for structural drift correction. We propose a Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization framework that treats physical interaction as an informative geometric constraint within a smoothing-based localization formulation. The method tightly fuses suction-based manipulator contact events with adaptive visual odometry, learned object detections, and on-board sensors. Visual odometry relative-pose factors and landmark bearing-range factors are uncertainty-scaled according to inlier statistics to prevent visually weak frames from destabilizing the estimator, while contact events are modeled as high-confidence factors that induce implicit loop closures without appearance-based place recognition. Furthermore, the system can fully initialize online during motion. Experimental evaluation in tanks, harbor, and simulation environments demonstrates that contact-induced constraints significantly reduce trajectory drift and improve object revisit accuracy compared to filtering-based navigation and contact-free graph formulations. These results highlight the role of embodied physical interaction as a localization primitive in perception-degraded underwater environments
summary_zh: 执行近海底采样任务的自主水下航行器的高精度状态估计始终是一大挑战。在低空作业场景下，面向无特征平坦海床的下视相机会产生尺度模糊、侧向退化与特征跟踪不一致的问题。仅靠惯性传感器与多普勒测速仪（DVL）融合无法实现结构漂移校正。本文提出一种接触辅助因子图定位框架，将物理交互作为信息丰富的几何约束引入基于平滑的定位公式中。该方法将基于吸力的机械臂接触事件与自适应视觉里程计、学习得到的目标检测结果、机载传感器进行紧耦合融合。视觉里程计相对位姿因子与地标方位-距离因子根据内点统计量进行不确定性缩放，避免视觉质量较差的帧破坏估计器稳定性；接触事件被建模为高置信度因子，无需基于外观的位置识别即可生成隐式回环。此外，该系统可在运动过程中完成全在线初始化。在水池、港口与仿真环境中的实验结果表明，与基于滤波的导航方案、无接触的图优化方案相比，接触引入的约束可显著降低轨迹漂移，提升目标重访精度。上述结果证明，在感知退化的水下环境中，具身物理交互可作为一种基础定位原语发挥重要作用。

title: Beyond Shallow-Water Photorealism: Physically and Sensor-Grounded Simulation for Deep-Sea Robotics
title_zh: 超越浅水区真实感：面向深海机器人的物理与传感器保真仿真系统
authors: Michele Grimaldi, Enrico Di Maria, Ignacio Carlucho, Yvan R. Petillot
abstract: Many recent underwater simulators emphasize visual realism at the expense of physical fidelity, focusing on shallow-water effects with limited relevance in deep-water environments and high computational cost. In this work, we shift the focus toward deep-sea physical and sensor realism. We present a physics- and sensor-grounded extension of the Stonefish simulator that augments its hydrodynamic models with stochastic IMU and DVL drift, magnetometer disturbances, higher-order hydrodynamics, terramechanics, pressure-driven environmental variability, and physically based underwater optics. These additions are designed to better capture the forces and measurements shaping the behavior of deep-ocean AUVs, ROVs, landers, ASVs, and gliders, while remaining compatible with real-time simulation. This work advances underwater simulation toward more representative deep-sea operating conditions, which is particularly relevant for long-duration navigation and learning-based autonomy, where inaccurate sensor and environmental models introduce non-physical artifacts and overly optimistic performance. While challenges remain, including complex fluid-structure interactions and full environmental stochasticity, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for navigation, perception, and autonomy research under deep-sea conditions.
summary_zh: 近期多数水下仿真器为提升视觉真实感牺牲了物理保真度，重点模拟与深海环境关联度极低的浅水区效应，且计算成本高昂。本文将研究重点转向深海物理与传感器真实感，提出Stonefish仿真器的物理与传感器保真扩展版本，在原有水动力模型基础上新增随机IMU与DVL漂移、磁力仪扰动、高阶水动力模型、地面力学、压力驱动的环境时变特性，以及基于物理的水下光学模型。上述新增模块可更准确地刻画影响深海自主水下航行器、遥控无人潜水器、着陆器、水面无人艇与水下滑翔机行为的作用力与测量特性，同时兼容实时仿真要求。本工作推动水下仿真向更符合深海实际运行条件的方向发展，对于长时序导航与基于学习的自主技术尤为重要——这类场景下不准确的传感器与环境模型会引入非物理伪影，导致仿真性能过于乐观。尽管目前仍存在复杂流固耦合、全环境随机性等挑战，所提框架可为深海场景下的导航、感知与自主技术研究提供实用基础。

title: Active Surface-Driven Reconfigurable Gripper: Robust Grasping and Sequential Manipulation of Thin Objects
title_zh: 主动表面驱动的可重构夹爪：面向薄型物体的鲁棒抓取与序列操作
authors: Ziyi Zheng, Keqi Zhu, Hao Wu, Yanzhe Wang, Huixu Dong
abstract: Robotic grippers face substantial challenges in grasping and manipulating thin objects. Most existing grippers rely on highly precise approach and grasp motions, which limits robustness and reduces applicability. This paper explores thin-object grasping using books as a representative example. Here, we propose a novel solution that integrates an active surface with underactuated compliance to achieve stable grasping of thin objects without complex control. First, an underactuated gripper with an active surface is designed. The active-surface thumb performs in-hand repositioning of the target book without requiring adjustments of the robot arm or the other fingers, while the underactuated fingers establish compliant contact conditions with the environment, and the reconfigurable structure enables reliable grasping of books under different configurations. Second, we establish a kinematic model of the gripper, and determine the initial grasp postures for two representative scenarios (books lying flat on a desktop and books vertically packed in a shelf). Third, by analyzing the physical model of a book lying on a table and its interaction with the gripper and the environment, we systematically optimize the structural parameters and grasping strategy. Finally, extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed gripper and strategy. The results demonstrate strong robustness and adaptability when grasping thin objects placed flat (including books, paper, fabric, plastic film, and mouse pad), as well as a high success rate when grasping vertically packed books. Moreover, the proposed gripper can reliably complete long sequential "grasp-place" tasks.
summary_zh: 机器人夹爪在抓取与操作薄型物体时面临诸多挑战。现有多数夹爪依赖精度极高的接近与抓取动作，鲁棒性差，适用场景受限。本文以书籍作为典型代表，探索薄型物体的抓取方案，提出一种融合主动表面与欠驱动柔顺特性的新型解决方案，无需复杂控制即可实现薄型物体的稳定抓取。首先，本文设计了一款带主动表面的欠驱动夹爪：带主动表面的拇指可在不调整机械臂或其余手指的情况下，在手中完成目标书籍的重定位，欠驱动手指可与环境建立柔顺接触条件，可重构结构可在不同构型下实现书籍的可靠抓取。其次，本文建立了夹爪的运动学模型，针对两类典型场景（平放在桌面上的书籍、竖直排列在书架中的书籍）确定了初始抓取位姿。第三，通过分析平放在桌面上的书籍的物理模型，以及书籍与夹爪、环境的交互关系，系统优化了结构参数与抓取策略。最后，大量实验验证了所提夹爪与策略的有效性：该夹爪对平放的薄型物体（包括书籍、纸张、织物、塑料薄膜、鼠标垫）表现出极强的鲁棒性与适应性，抓取竖直排列书籍的成功率很高，且可可靠完成长序列的“抓取-放置”任务。

title: TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
title_zh: TemporalFlow-VLA（时域流视觉-语言-动作模型）：面向长时域机器人操作的物理锚定执行历史学习
authors: Jiarui Yang, Yehao Lu, Yuning Su, Yu Zhong, Yufeng Xie 等 (12 人)
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for robot control, yet simply adding historical frames does not reliably capture recent physical change. This is especially problematic in multi-stage manipulation, where visually similar states may require different actions depending on prior execution. To address this challenge, we present TemporalFlow-VLA, which learns compact execution history through physically grounded temporal supervision. Using recorded robot states, robot geometry, and calibrated cameras, we construct robot-surface temporal flow as a training-only target and supervise two execution-aligned temporal queries that provide structured history to the action expert. The geometric supervision path is not evaluated at deployment. TemporalFlow-VLA achieves 97.63 +/- 0.26% average success on LIBERO, including 96.60 +/- 0.87% on LIBERO Long, and 85.5%/84.2% Clean/Randomized success across 12 RoboTwin tasks. It shows its clearest advantage over prior methods on longer-horizon, multi-stage manipulation. Controlled history interventions show that action prediction depends on both historical content and temporal order. With asynchronous feature caching, temporal conditioning maintains single-frame-level server-side sampling latency without additional historical-encoding overhead. Overall, TemporalFlow-VLA provides a compact, physically grounded interface for exploiting ordered execution history without explicit motion estimation or geometric processing at deployment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型利用预训练的视觉-语言表征实现机器人控制，但仅简单拼接历史帧无法可靠捕捉近期物理变化，这一问题在多阶段操作场景中尤为突出：视觉相似的状态可能因前期执行动作不同需要输出完全不同的后续动作。为解决该挑战，本文提出TemporalFlow-VLA模型，通过物理锚定的时域监督学习得到紧凑的执行历史表征。研究利用记录的机器人状态、机器人几何参数与标定后的相机，构建仅用于训练的机器人-表面时域流作为训练目标，对两个执行对齐的时域查询模块进行监督，为动作专家提供结构化历史信息。该几何监督路径在部署阶段无需运行。TemporalFlow-VLA在LIBERO基准上取得97.63±0.26%的平均成功率，其中LIBERO长时域子集成功率达96.60±0.87%，在12项RoboTwin任务中，干净场景与随机化场景的成功率分别为85.5%和84.2%。相较于现有方法，该模型在长时域、多阶段操作任务中优势最为显著。受控历史干预实验表明，动作预测同时依赖历史内容与时序顺序。通过异步特征缓存，时域条件机制可保持单帧级服务器端采样延迟，不会引入额外的历史编码开销。总体而言，TemporalFlow-VLA提供了紧凑的物理锚定接口，可在部署阶段无需显式运动估计或几何处理的前提下利用有序执行历史信息。

title: CLIPPER: Replayable Shortlisted Optimization for Repeated Spatial Coverage Planning
title_zh: CLIPPER（带池化评估与回放的约束精确低延迟迭代规划方法）：面向重复空间覆盖规划的可回放候选集优化
authors: Julian Teusch, Jörg Philipp Müller, Monika Sester
abstract: Operational requirements developed with the City of Braunschweig frame municipal micromobility planning under geofenced exclusions, mandatory retained sites, spacing rules, and area-level caps. Each policy edit requires a new feasible plan; full-set greedy takes tens of seconds per alternative at city scale. We present CLIPPER (Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay). It forms bounded candidate pools but recomputes exact current gains and checks every active constraint before selection. Coverage from each candidate alone sets the initial order. Offline full-set scans measure gains omitted by the pool; online, a conservative bound triggers expansion or audit. CLIPPER-F gives each proposal group the same number of candidate slots. Across Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin, its mean coverage over complete chains stays within 0.245 percentage points of full-set greedy under the same policy, with 13.6--28.9 times lower mean rollout time. CLIPPER-A instead distributes one shared candidate budget across the groups. Under its coverage-prioritized policy, it uses 9--15% of full-set greedy's rollout time under the same policy, with mean gaps of 1.82 percentage points in Braunschweig, 0.12 in Munich, and 0.27 in Berlin. Together, CLIPPER enables rapid, replayable comparison of recorded city-scale planning states while enforcing every encoded model constraint.
summary_zh: 与不伦瑞克市联合制定的城市微型移动交通运营规划要求需满足地理围栏禁入区域、强制保留点位、间距规则与区域级配额等多重约束，每调整一次政策就需要生成新的可行规划方案，而城市尺度下全集合贪心算法处理单个备选方案的耗时可达数十秒。本文提出CLIPPER框架，全称为带池化评估与回放的约束精确低延迟迭代规划方法，该框架构建有界候选池，但在选择前会重新计算精确的当前收益并校验所有激活约束。单个候选点的覆盖范围决定初始排序，离线全集合扫描可测量候选池遗漏的收益，在线运行时通过保守边界触发候选池扩展或结果审计。CLIPPER-F变体为每个提案组分配相同数量的候选槽位，在不伦瑞克、慕尼黑、柏林三个城市的测试中，相同政策下其完整规划链的平均覆盖度与全集合贪心算法的差距不超过0.245个百分点，平均推演耗时降低13.6~28.9倍。CLIPPER-A变体则将共享候选预算在各组间动态分配，在覆盖度优先策略下，其推演耗时仅为全集合贪心算法的9%~15%，在不伦瑞克、慕尼黑、柏林三地的平均覆盖度差距分别为1.82、0.12、0.27个百分点。综上，CLIPPER可在强制执行所有编码模型约束的前提下，实现城市尺度规划状态的快速可回放对比。

title: Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling
title_zh: 面向动态操作技能的机器人端快速学习：机器人杂耍任务
authors: Taeyoon Lee, Chunpeng Wang, Christopher G. Atkeson, Alfred A. Rizzi, Nicolas Rojas
abstract: We present an online learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to acquire diverse juggling patterns directly on physical hardware within minutes, even with a significant sim2real gap. One of the most important lessons from this work is that a model, even when far from reality, can be extremely useful for learning. This motivates a central philosophy of our approach: learning should build upon the robot's current knowledge rather than replace it. Our regularized memory-based learning puts this principle into practice by learning a local model from accumulated experience while retaining the global prior model to extrapolate where experience is sparse. This enables efficient and stable online learning from each new experience without resorting to uninformed exploration over a vast space of possible behaviors. Equally important to continual on-robot learning is safety, allowing the robot to repeatedly practice and improve in the real world. We construct a mutually reachable set that allows safe transitions between successive throws and catches, without driving either arm into a state from which its next action would require violating the robot's joint or actuator limits. Together, these ideas enable a bimanual robot with multi-fingered hands and onboard vision to safely learn and compose five canonical three-ball juggling patterns, including cascade, tennis, half-shower, shower, and box, within less than 5 minutes of real-world interaction. More broadly, this work points toward robots that build upon imperfect prior knowledge and continually refine their behavior through their own real-world experience.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种在线学习框架，可让双臂机器人在存在显著sim2real（仿真到现实）差距的前提下，直接在实体硬件上数分钟内掌握多种杂耍模式。本研究最重要的结论之一是：即使与真实场景偏差很大的模型也能为学习过程提供极高的价值，这也引出了本方法的核心理念：学习过程应当基于机器人已有的知识迭代优化，而非完全替换原有知识。本文提出的正则化记忆学习机制将该理念落地：从累积的经验中学习局部模型，同时保留全局先验模型用于经验稀疏区域的外推，无需在庞大的行为空间中进行无引导探索即可从每一次新经验中实现高效稳定的在线学习。机器人端持续学习的另一核心要素是安全性，保证机器人可在真实场景中反复练习迭代优化。本文构建了互可达集，可实现连续抛接动作间的安全过渡，不会让任意机械臂进入后续动作需要违反机器人关节或驱动器限制的状态。上述机制共同让搭载多指手与机载视觉的双臂机器人可在不足5分钟的真实交互时间内，安全学习并组合5种经典三球杂耍模式：瀑布式、网球式、半喷淋式、喷淋式与盒式。更广泛地看，本研究为机器人基于不完美先验知识、通过真实世界经验持续优化自身行为提供了新的技术路径。

title: Online Joint Calibration of Steering Offset and Planar LiDAR Extrinsics for Wheeled Mobile Robots
title_zh: 面向轮式移动机器人的转向偏移与平面激光雷达外参在线联合标定
authors: Subodh Mishra, Arindam Dhar, Suprotim Majumdar, Naveen Arulselvan
abstract: Accurate steering sensing and LiDAR-to-vehicle extrinsics are crucial for reliable path tracking in warehouse mobile robots (WMRs); miscalibration often leads to snaking, weaving, and elevated cross-track error (CTE). In practice, steering ``zero'' is commonly set manually (e.g., eyeballing straightness via a PS4 joystick), while LiDAR extrinsics are assumed from CAD and may drift after maintenance. Such static, manual procedures frequently cause miscalibration in safety-critical environments. This paper presents an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)--based method for online estimation of steering offset and planar LiDAR extrinsics within a bicycle-kinematics model, providing a principled alternative to manual calibration. Experiments on real datasets show that correcting steering offset reduces CTE substantially, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 精准的转向传感与激光雷达-车体外参是仓库移动机器人（WMR）可靠路径跟踪的核心基础，标定误差往往会导致机器人行驶轨迹蛇形、摆动，大幅提升跨轨迹误差（CTE）。实际场景中，转向零点通常采用手动设置（例如通过PS4摇杆目视对齐直线行驶方向），而激光雷达外参往往直接沿用CAD设计值，在设备维护后容易出现漂移。这类静态手动标定流程在安全关键场景中极易引发标定失效问题。本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的方法，在自行车运动学模型框架下在线估计转向偏移与平面激光雷达外参，为手动标定提供了严谨的替代方案。真实数据集实验表明，修正转向偏移可大幅降低跨轨迹误差，验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents
title_zh: 面向可指令智能体的规划与控制解耦方法
authors: Zineng Tang, Kelsey R. Allen, Sjoerd van Steenkiste, Ishita Dasgupta, Alane Suhr
abstract: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model controller to act autonomously at high frequency when conditioned on sparse, higher-latency, and high-level text instructions generated by a VLM planner. To train controllers to be language-instructable, we relabel segments of controller policy rollouts with synthetic instructions and jointly optimize a behavior-cloning objective along with existing reward-maximizing and world-modeling objectives. We evaluate our proposed approach across seven embodied environments, including three multi-agent environments where VLM planners coordinate through language while trained controllers serve as their actuators. Under matched observation and action spaces, our decoupled approach consistently outperforms controller-only and direct VLM action-generation variants, preserves fast control, and lets us swap in different pretrained VLM planners without fine-tuning, while remaining competitive with strong vision-language-action and multi-agent RL baselines on six of seven tasks.
summary_zh: 现有研究表明，经过预训练与指令微调的视觉语言模型（VLM）可很好地实现从指令与观测到高层规划的映射，但很难将这类规划转化为陌生环境下可靠的低延迟动作序列。与此同时，基于世界模型的控制器擅长实现快速的观测到动作控制，但缺乏开放式任务引导能力。本文将两类方法的优势整合为统一系统Instruct-to-Act（指令转动作系统）：训练世界模型控制器，使其在VLM规划器生成的稀疏、高延迟高层文本指令的条件下自主高频运行。为训练出可被语言指令驱动的控制器，本文对控制器策略推演的片段用合成指令重新标注，将行为克隆目标与现有奖励最大化、世界建模目标联合优化。在7个具身环境中开展评估，其中包含3个多智能体环境：VLM规划器通过语言实现协同，训练得到的控制器作为执行器运行。在观测与动作空间对齐的条件下，本文提出的解耦方法性能始终优于纯控制器变体与VLM直接生成动作的变体，既保留了快速控制特性，也支持直接替换不同的预训练VLM规划器而无需微调，在7个任务中的6个上性能与当前最优视觉-语言-动作模型、多智能体强化学习基线相当。

title: MeshPriorDiT: Hierarchical Modeling for Action-Conditioned Cloth Dynamics
title_zh: MeshPriorDiT：面向动作条件布料动力学的分层建模方法
authors: Zihang Wang, Jianming Hu, Shang Su, Hao Huang, Mengkai Shi 等 (7 人)
abstract: Action-conditioned cloth dynamics prediction requires both locally plausible deformation and long-range coordination. Existing approaches largely follow two paradigms. Mesh-based GNNs capture local physical responses through material connectivity. However, their finite message-passing range limits coordination between topologically distant regions, while autoregressive rollouts tend to accumulate prediction errors. Transformer-based dynamics models capture long-range interactions through global attention, but often operate without explicit material connectivity and must learn local topological responses directly from data. We propose MeshPriorDiT, a hierarchical dynamics model that decomposes future cloth motion into a structured mesh prior and a generative residual. An action-conditioned mesh GNN first predicts multi-step vertex displacements, yielding a reference trajectory that respects material topology and grasp constraints. Conditioned on historical states, planned actions, and the mesh prior, a Residual DiT then uses conditional flow matching to jointly generate the residual motion not captured by the prior. The generated residual is further rescaled and decoded using material adjacency to coordinate corrections across neighboring vertices. We evaluate MeshPriorDiT on 15-step autoregressive rollouts across three cloth manipulation tasks. Averaged over the three tasks, MeshPriorDiT reduces average Global MSE by 43.42% relative to the GNN-Only baseline and by 75.03% relative to the DiT-DDPM baseline, while maintaining a favorable Edge-strain MSE comparable to that of GNN-Only.
summary_zh: 动作条件下的布料动力学预测同时需要局部合理形变与长程协同特性，现有方法主要遵循两类技术范式：基于网格的图神经网络（GNN）可通过材料连接关系捕捉局部物理响应，但其有限的消息传递范围限制了拓扑远距区域间的协同，且自回归推演过程容易累积预测误差；基于Transformer的动力学模型可通过全局注意力捕捉长程交互，但通常未显式建模材料连接关系，需要直接从数据中学习局部拓扑响应。本文提出MeshPriorDiT（网格先验扩散Transformer），一种分层动力学模型，将未来布料运动分解为结构化网格先验与生成残差两部分：首先通过动作条件网格GNN预测多步顶点位移，生成符合材料拓扑与抓取约束的参考轨迹；再以历史状态、规划动作与网格先验为条件，通过残差扩散Transformer利用条件流匹配生成先验未覆盖的残差运动，生成的残差进一步通过材料邻接关系重缩放与解码，实现相邻顶点间的校正协同。本文在3项布料操作任务的15步自回归推演设置下对MeshPriorDiT开展评估，三项任务平均结果显示，相较于纯GNN基线，MeshPriorDiT的全局均方误差降低43.42%，相较于DiT-DDPM基线降低75.03%，同时其边应变均方误差与纯GNN基线保持相当水平。

title: Fixed-Haven Reservation for Online Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in Dense Warehouses
title_zh: 面向密集仓库在线多智能体取放任务的固定安全区预留方法
authors: Taisei Hirayama, Kohei Yoshida, Hiroki Sakaji, Itsuki Noda
abstract: Dense warehouses often contain single-lane aisles, dead ends, and tree-like guidepaths that leave little room for idle agents to wait without blocking others. Existing Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery (MAPD) guarantees for completing all finitely released tasks typically rely on extra waiting endpoints that planned paths can avoid, or on biconnected topology; these assumptions may fail in such layouts. We study fixed-Haven reservation for online MAPD, where pickup-delivery tasks are released over time. Each agent owns a fixed Safe Haven (Haven for short), usually its start cell, that only the owner may occupy and that other agents treat as blocked. For finite task releases, we prove that this fixed-Haven contract completes all released tasks under Haven-Reachability and explicit planning/progress assumptions. We implement the contract in SHARP, a Safe-Haven Retreat Planner that keeps every busy or retreating agent on a collision-free reserved route ending at its Haven. We compare SHARP with representative TP and PIBT-family MAPD baselines: Token Passing (TP), Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT), and PIBT with Temporary Priority and Temporary Avoidance (PIBTTP-TA) for biconnected main areas with attached trees. In the robustness sweep, SHARP is the only method with 100% success on all tested configurations, at substantially higher centralized planning cost on tree-like layouts. A TP-style fixed-home-return counterfactual with full-route validation also recovers robustness on tested tree-like layouts, suggesting that fixed return is a central robustness mechanism there. A no-overwrite variant shows that disabling mid-retreat reassignment worsens service time (release-to-delivery latency) by 1.89 times and makespan by 1.53 times in the tested high-load tree condition.
summary_zh: 密集仓库通常包含单车道通道、死胡同与树状引导路径，空闲机器人几乎没有等待空间而不阻塞其他智能体。现有多智能体取放（MAPD）任务的全任务完成保障机制通常依赖规划路径可绕开的额外等待端点，或者要求拓扑为双连通结构，这类假设在上述仓库布局中往往不成立。本文研究面向在线MAPD任务的固定安全区预留机制：取放任务随时间动态释放，每个智能体拥有一个固定的安全区（简称Haven），通常为其起始栅格，仅所属智能体可占用该区域，其他智能体将其视为障碍。针对有限任务释放场景，本文证明在安全可达性与显式规划/进度假设下，该固定安全区契约可完成所有已释放任务。本文在SHARP（安全区撤退规划器）中实现了该契约，可保证所有处于工作或撤退状态的智能体运行在以其安全区为终点的无碰撞预留路径上。将SHARP与三类代表性MAPD基线方法对比：令牌传递法（TP）、带回溯的优先级继承法（PIBT）、面向双连通主区域加附属树状布局的带临时优先级与临时规避的PIBT（PIBTTP-TA）。鲁棒性遍历测试显示，SHARP是所有测试配置下唯一成功率达100%的方法，但其在树状布局中的集中式规划开销显著更高。采用全路径校验的类TP固定返回起点对照方法在树状布局中也实现了100%鲁棒性，说明固定返回机制是该场景下的核心鲁棒性保障机制。无覆盖写变体测试显示，在高负载树状场景下禁用撤退中途重分配会将服务时间（任务释放到送达的延迟）提升1.89倍，总完工时间提升1.53倍。

title: Residual Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Computed Torque Control for a Cable-Driven Lower-Limb Rehabilitation Robot under Disturbances and Parametric Uncertainties
title_zh: 扰动与参数不确定性场景下基于残差深度强化学习的缆驱动下肢康复机器人计算力矩控制
authors: Mohammad-Hossein Fakouri, Ali Keymasi-Khalaji
abstract: Accurate trajectory tracking in cable-driven lower-limb rehabilitation robots is challenging because model uncertainty, external disturbances, joint constraints, and pull-only cable actuation can degrade nominal control performance. Conventional model-based controllers provide an interpretable control structure but remain sensitive to model mismatch, whereas fully learning-based control can reduce transparency and complicate constraint-aware operation. This study proposes a residual deep reinforcement learning-enhanced computed torque control framework in which computed torque control generates the nominal command and a bounded Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient policy supplies only an additional compensating torque. The approach is evaluated in simulation under nominal, uncertain, disturbed, combined, and generalization conditions, together with trajectory-tracking, joint-limit, cable-demand, workspace-feasibility, and cable-Jacobian diagnostics. Across the evaluated conditions, the residual controller improves tracking and disturbance rejection relative to computed torque control while preserving the interpretable model-based command structure and satisfying the reported feasibility checks in the representative evaluation. Broader tests indicate that tracking improvements can persist beyond the representative case while also exposing trajectory-dependent constraint limitations. These results support bounded residual learning as a practical robustness-enhancement strategy for simulation-based rehabilitation robot control and motivate further constraint-aware and experimental validation.
summary_zh: 缆驱动下肢康复机器人的高精度轨迹跟踪极具挑战：模型不确定性、外部扰动、关节约束与缆绳仅可拉拽的驱动特性都会降低标称控制性能。传统基于模型的控制器具备可解释的控制结构，但对模型失配非常敏感；纯基于学习的控制器则会降低透明度，让约束感知运行变得复杂。本研究提出残差深度强化学习增强的计算力矩控制框架：计算力矩控制生成标称控制指令，有界的深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）策略仅输出额外的补偿力矩。在标称、不确定、扰动、组合、泛化五类场景下开展仿真评估，同时对轨迹跟踪、关节限制、缆绳需求、工作空间可行性、缆绳雅可比矩阵五类指标进行校验。所有测试场景下，相较于纯计算力矩控制，该残差控制器的跟踪性能与扰动抑制能力均有提升，同时保留了可解释的基于模型指令结构，在代表性评估场景中完全满足所有可行性校验要求。扩展测试显示跟踪性能提升可泛化到代表性场景之外，同时也暴露了轨迹相关的约束局限性。上述结果证明，有界残差学习是仿真场景下康复机器人控制的实用鲁棒性增强策略，后续可进一步开展约束感知优化与实体实验验证。

title: PredVLA: A Sub-Million-Parameter Predictive-Coding Policy for Robot Manipulation
title_zh: PredVLA：面向机器人操作的百万参数级以下预测编码策略
authors: Hiroki Sawada, Shunichi Kasahara
abstract: Large pretrained vision-language-action models dominate modern robot-manipulation benchmarks, but it remains unclear how much model scale is necessary for strong language-conditioned control, or whether fundamentally different control architectures can remain competitive at much smaller parameter budgets. We present PredVLA, a language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with only 0.68 million trainable network parameters and no robot-data pretraining, whose hierarchical generative recurrent dynamics predict visual features and proprioception while observations influence latent state only through online inference from the resulting sensory prediction errors. On LIBERO, PredVLA achieves an 86.9% mean success rate across the three short-horizon suites and 75.4% when the long-horizon suite is included. Under a controlled comparison using the same frozen front end, demonstrations, action decoder, and evaluation protocol, PredVLA achieves 3.7x and 7.4x mean success rates of parameter-matched Transformer and LSTM policies, respectively. The predictive-coding formulation also makes the contribution of observation-driven correction directly measurable: because observations influence the recurrent state only through prediction-error-based latent inference, disabling this inference yields an exact open-loop control condition. Together, these results show that a sub-million-parameter recurrent generative policy can achieve strong performance on modern language-conditioned manipulation benchmarks while providing an explicit mechanism for prediction-error-driven online state correction.
summary_zh: 大尺寸预训练视觉-语言-动作模型是当前机器人操作基准的主流方案，但目前学界尚不清楚强语言条件控制所需的最小模型规模，也不确定是否存在完全不同的控制架构可在极低参数预算下保持相当性能。本文提出PredVLA，一种语言条件预测编码策略，仅包含68万可训练网络参数，且无需任何机器人数据预训练：其分层生成循环动力学模块预测视觉特征与本体感知，观测仅能通过预测误差驱动的在线推理过程影响隐状态。在LIBERO基准上，PredVLA在3个短时域子集上的平均成功率达86.9%，加入长时域子集后平均成功率达75.4%。在控制前端、演示数据、动作解码器、评估协议完全一致的对照实验中，PredVLA的平均成功率分别是参数量匹配的Transformer策略与LSTM策略的3.7倍与7.4倍。预测编码架构还可直接量化观测校正的贡献：由于观测仅能通过基于预测误差的隐状态推理影响循环状态，禁用该推理即可得到纯开环控制对照条件。上述结果表明，百万参数级以下的循环生成策略可在当前主流语言条件操作基准上取得优异性能，同时提供了预测误差驱动的显式在线状态校正机制。

title: FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: FLARE：面向视觉语言机器人操作的自主纠错与恢复故障感知框架
authors: Ganlong Zhao, Zijia Tang, Xingping Chen, Zhanghui Kuang, Ye Tian 等 (6 人)
abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models~(VLAs) have demonstrated significant promise in generalizing to complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. However, their performance remains brittle, as they are typically trained on trajectory-monotonic, failure-free demonstrations. This reliance on ``perfect" data leaves them unable to recover from common execution errors, such as a missed grasp, a dropped object, or an unexpected collision. In this paper, we propose FLARE, a novel framework that endows VLAs with robust error recovery capabilities through a ``Retry" and ``Reset" paradigm. First, we introduce a ``Retry" mechanism by injecting perturbation and bridging segments that decouple robot pose from environment state into demonstrations, enabling the policy to autonomously handle execution deviations. Second, to address critical, state-breaking (OOD) failures, we introduce a ``Reset" pipeline. We leverage an MLLM for offline failure analysis to automatically identify OOD states from execution videos. This analysis enables the efficient, targeted collection of a small library of object-centric ``Reset" skills, which are trained to restore the environment to a task-valid state. Our full framework integrates these learned policies. At inference, an online MLLM monitor arbitrates between task execution and ``Reset" skills. Experiments on challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks show our approach significantly improves task success and robustness.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在复杂长时域机器人操作任务泛化场景中展现出巨大潜力，但其性能鲁棒性不足：这类模型通常基于轨迹单调、无故障的演示数据训练，对“完美数据”的依赖使其无法从常见执行错误中恢复，例如抓取失败、物体掉落、意外碰撞等。本文提出FLARE框架，通过“重试+重置”范式为VLA模型赋予鲁棒的错误恢复能力。首先，本文引入“重试”机制：在演示数据中注入扰动与桥接片段，将机器人位姿与环境状态解耦，让策略可自主处理执行偏差。其次，针对严重的破环态分布外（OOD）故障，本文提出“重置”流水线：利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）开展离线故障分析，从执行视频中自动识别分布外状态，基于分析结果高效定向采集以物体为中心的小型“重置”技能库，训练对应的技能将环境恢复到任务合法状态。完整框架将上述学习得到的策略整合，推理阶段由在线MLLM监控器在任务执行与重置技能间做仲裁。在高接触复杂操作任务上的实验表明，本文提出的方法可显著提升任务成功率与鲁棒性。

title: Relaxation-Aware Multimodal Sensing of Soft Gripper Driven by Structure-Perception-Learning
title_zh: 基于结构-感知-学习框架的松弛感知型软体抓手多模态传感技术
authors: Yanzhe Wang, Hao Wu, Ziyi Zheng, Huixu Dong
abstract: Achieving stable, sustained grasping with soft robotic hands remains a fundamental challenge. Compliance enables safe and adaptive contact, yet the intrinsic viscoelasticity of soft polymers leads to stress relaxation and a continuous decay of grasping force during holding. Inspired by human grasping, which combines phase-dependent stiffness regulation with continuous sensing and feedback, this paper presents an integrated structure--perception--learning framework. We develop a variable-stiffness soft gripper that uses onboard vision and infrared thermography to track deformation and the temperature field in real time, preserving continuous tracking of the interaction state. To mitigate relaxation-induced force decay, we propose a temperature-coupled viscoelastic force representation, together with a physics-informed learning model, to reconstruct the force trend and provide explicit compensation during holding. Experiments show that, in a 280s force-controlled grasp-and-hold task, the proposed method maintains the desired force with a mean absolute error of 0.066N, outperforming fixed-aperture and instantaneous-only baselines by 80% and 95%, respectively. Overall, the results support a mechanism--AI co-design view: mechanisms shape feasible interactions, while learning compensates remaining uncertainty in viscoelastic dynamics, together enabling stable, sustained grasping.
summary_zh: 软体机器人手实现稳定持续抓取仍是领域核心挑战。柔顺特性可实现安全自适应接触，但软质聚合物的固有粘弹性会引发应力松弛，导致持握过程中抓取力持续衰减。受人类抓取行为（结合相位相关刚度调节与连续传感反馈）的启发，本文提出一套集成化的结构-感知-学习框架。研发了一款变刚度软体抓手，搭载机载视觉与红外热成像模块实时追踪形变与温度场，实现交互状态的连续跟踪。为缓解松弛引发的力衰减问题，提出温度耦合的粘弹性力表征方法，结合物理信息学习模型重构力变化趋势，在持握阶段提供显式补偿。实验表明，在280秒力控抓取持握任务中，所提方法可将期望力的平均绝对误差维持在0.066N，性能较固定开度基线方法与仅瞬时反馈基线方法分别提升80%和95%。整体结果验证了机构-人工智能协同设计的思路：机构塑造可行交互模式，学习算法补偿粘弹性动力学中的剩余不确定性，二者协同实现稳定持续抓取。

title: SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
title_zh: SOLO：面向人形机器人的稳定全地形长周期感知运动技术
authors: Pihai Sun, Gang Han, Jingkai Sun, Jiahao Ma, Zeran Su 等 (20 人)
abstract: Humans traverse complex terrain over long distances without losing balance, whereas perceptive humanoid policies become fragile as perception and control errors accumulate. We present SOLO, a unified framework addressing two compounding causes of this long-horizon fragility: dense terrain reconstruction smooths action-critical details, and pointwise imitation lacks temporal credit assignment. Its Query Reconstructor (QR) uses Fourier-encoded cell queries to retrieve spatially specific evidence from depth-proprioception tokens, preserving sharp terrain boundaries. Trajectory-Aware MSE (TA-MSE) Distillation adds next-state teacher-student disagreement to the PPO reward, enabling Generalized Advantage Estimation to propagate future disagreement penalties to preceding actions. In simulation, QR reduces height-map L1 error by factors of 3.3-4.0, while TA-MSE surpasses PPO and MSE+PPO in curriculum progression. On stress-test terrains, SOLO achieves 97.5% mean traversal success and 96% stepping-stone success, versus 75.0-75.6% and 0-3% for dense-reconstructor variants. Deployed zero-shot with only a chest-mounted depth camera and proprioception, SOLO completes a continuous 1.5-km outdoor route and an indoor mixed-terrain course. Project page:this https URL
summary_zh: 人类可长距离穿越复杂地形且不会失衡，而感知型人形机器人的控制策略会随着感知与控制误差累积逐渐失稳。本文提出SOLO统一框架，针对性解决长周期失稳的两大核心诱因：密集地形重构会平滑对动作至关重要的细节，逐点模仿缺乏时序信用分配机制。其内置的Query Reconstructor（QR，查询重构器）采用傅里叶编码的单元查询机制，从深度-本体感知令牌中检索空间特定证据，保留清晰的地形边界。Trajectory-Aware MSE（TA-MSE，轨迹感知均方误差）蒸馏机制将下一状态的师生模型差异引入PPO（近端策略优化）奖励函数，使广义优势估计可将未来的差异惩罚反向传播至前置动作。仿真实验中，QR可将高度图L1误差降低3.3~4.0倍，TA-MSE在课程学习进度上的表现超越PPO与MSE+PPO基线方案。在压力测试地形中，SOLO的平均穿越成功率达97.5%，踏石任务成功率达96%，而密集重构器变体方案的对应指标仅为75.0%~75.6%和0~3%。仅搭载胸部深度相机与本体感知模块的SOLO可实现零样本部署，完成总长1.5km的连续户外路线与室内混合地形课程任务。项目页链接见原文给出的URL。

title: Arrive and Survive: Scaling Safe Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning from One-Bit Failure Signals
title_zh: 抵达并存活：基于单比特失败信号的安全目标条件策略学习规模化方法
authors: Guopeng Li, Yiyang Duan, Yiru Jiao, Chengcheng Xu
abstract: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) scales effectively in goal-conditioned tasks by casting policy learning into a self-supervised contrastive objective. However, in a failure-terminated Markov decision process, established CRL considers pre-failure future goals only when constructing positive samples, without accounting for the probability mass removed by failure termination. Our theoretical analysis shows that this omission induces a systematic overestimation bias in goal-reaching values. Consequently, near-failure trajectories provide disproportionately strong supervision of success despite retaining little future occupancy. Unsafe actions can thereby be reinforced through catastrophic failure bootstrapping, leading to failed policy learning and unsustainable goal-reaching behaviours. To address this problem, we introduce two minimal yet strong corrections: mass-weighted InfoNCE corrects the overweighting of short surviving futures in critic learning, and a log-survival-mass score restores the missing survival mass in policy optimization. The resulting method, Safe Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (Safe-CRL), requires only the one-bit signal provided by failure termination to scale safe goal-conditioned policy learning. Across twelve failure-prone robot navigation and locomotion tasks, Safe-CRL consistently improves survival and substantially outperforms the Scaling-CRL baseline in goal-reaching performance. Additionally, deep Safe-CRL policies exhibit complex failure-avoidance behaviours. This study completes the CRL theory under failure termination and provides a scalable safe RL framework. The code is available viathis https URL.
summary_zh: 对比强化学习（CRL）通过将策略学习转化为自监督对比目标，可在目标条件任务中实现高效规模化。但在失败终止型马尔可夫决策过程中，现有CRL方法仅在构造正样本时考虑失败前的未来目标，未计入失败终止所移除的概率质量。理论分析表明，该遗漏会引发目标到达值的系统性高估偏差。最终，接近失败的轨迹尽管未来占用度极低，却会对成功信号产生不成比例的强监督作用，进而通过灾难性失败自举强化不安全动作，导致策略学习失败、目标到达行为不可持续。为解决该问题，本文提出两项轻量且高效的修正机制：质量加权InfoNCE修正评论家学习中短存活未来的过度加权问题，对数存活质量分数恢复策略优化中缺失的存活质量。最终得到的Safe Contrastive Reinforcement Learning（Safe-CRL，安全对比强化学习）方法仅需失败终止输出的单比特信号，即可实现安全目标条件策略学习的规模化。在12项高失败风险机器人导航与运动任务中，Safe-CRL可持续提升存活表现，在目标到达性能上大幅优于Scaling-CRL基线方案。此外，深度Safe-CRL策略可生成复杂的避障行为。本研究完善了失败终止条件下的CRL理论，提供了一套可规模化的安全强化学习框架。代码可通过原文给出的URL获取。

title: Memory Anchors for Continual Robot Learning
title_zh: 面向机器人持续学习的记忆锚点方法
authors: Maximilian Du, Zhanyi Sun, Chen Xu, Paarth Shah, Masha Itkina 等 (6 人)
abstract: Robot policies deployed in the wild should have the capability to continually learn new tasks without forgetting existing behaviors. A common approach to combat such catastrophic forgetting is to train on new task data with a replay buffer of previously learned task data. Although this buffer is commonly sampled randomly from all prior experiences, we show that a small set of these experiences contributes greatly in anchoring past performance. We call these experiences Memory Anchors. We identify Memory Anchors in regions where representations of new-task observations collapse onto those of old-task observations even though the tasks require conflicting actions, like when a familiar object must be manipulated in a new way. Rehearsing old data in this region plays a key role in preventing destructive overwriting of past task knowledge, serving as this critical Memory Anchor role. Excluding only 10% Memory Anchors before sampling the buffer leads to more than a 4.5x increase in catastrophic forgetting on the LIBERO benchmark suites. Conversely, enriching the replay buffer with Memory Anchors can decrease high-conflict task forgetting by 63% and enables successful continual learning of two task sequences on a real robot. Videos and additional visualizations can be found atthis https URL
summary_zh: 真实场景部署的机器人策略需具备持续学习新任务且不遗忘已有行为的能力。缓解这类灾难性遗忘的常用方案是使用存储了过往学习任务数据的重放缓冲区，结合新任务数据共同训练。尽管现有缓冲区通常从所有过往经验中随机采样，本研究发现其中一小部分经验可在锚定过往性能上发挥极大作用，我们将这类经验定义为记忆锚点。记忆锚点分布在新任务观测表征与旧任务观测表征发生坍缩重合、但两类任务要求执行冲突动作的区域，例如需要以全新方式操作熟悉物体的场景。对该区域的旧数据进行重放，可有效防止过往任务知识被破坏性覆盖，发挥关键的锚定作用。在缓冲区采样前仅移除10%的记忆锚点，就会导致LIBERO基准套件上的灾难性遗忘程度提升4.5倍以上。反之，通过向重放缓冲区补充记忆锚点，可将高冲突任务的遗忘率降低63%，在真实机器人上实现两类任务序列的成功持续学习。相关视频与可视化内容可访问原文给出的URL查看。

title: Barrier Function Conformal Safety Clearance Certification with CVaR for Driving Trajectory Selection
title_zh: 面向驾驶轨迹选择的结合CVaR（条件风险值）的屏障函数共形安全间隙认证方法
authors: Pei Yu Chang, Qadeer Ahmed
abstract: Autonomous driving motion planners generate and select candidate trajectories while accounting for interactions with surrounding agents. However, these evaluations do not certify the actual safety clearance of the selected trajectory. The framework evaluates the trajectory selected by ant planners and calibrates the gap between its plan time margin and realized safety clearance. A differentiable separating axis barrier margin deterministically lower bounds exact signed oriented-bounding-box (OBB) safety clearance, connecting the statistical certificate to safety margin. At plan time, the margin is evaluated using either a nominal prediction and sampled lower tail Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), while post-selection conformal calibration over exchangeable drive sessions absorbs prediction and sampling errors. Conformal calibration provides statistical validity independently of predictor correctness. The method is evaluated on a frozen 300 session nuPlan study using native Predictive Driver Model (PDM) Closed loop proposals. At 10% target miscoverage, sampled lower CVaR reduces the conformal correction from 1.43m to 0.03m and increases the rate of nonnegative safety clearance certificates from 68.7% to 87.3%. Across all evaluated statistics, exact-clearance coverage remains above the 90% target at 93.3--96.7%.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶运动规划器在生成与筛选候选轨迹时需要考虑与周边交通参与者的交互，但现有评估机制无法对所选轨迹的实际安全间隙进行认证。本文提出的框架可评估任意规划器输出的轨迹，校准其规划阶段预留余量与实际安全间隙之间的偏差。可微分离轴屏障余量为精确的定向包围盒（OBB）安全间隙提供确定性下界，将统计认证与安全余量建立关联。在规划阶段，可通过标称预测与采样得到的下尾CVaR（条件风险值）完成余量评估，而轨迹选择完成后，基于可交换驾驶会话的共形校准可抵消预测与采样误差。共形校准的统计有效性不受预测器正确性的影响。本研究基于300个会话的冻结nuPlan数据集、使用原生Predictive Driver Model（PDM，预测驾驶员模型）闭环提案完成方法验证。在目标误覆盖率为10%的设置下，采样下尾CVaR可将共形校正值从1.43m降至0.03m，将非负安全间隙认证的占比从68.7%提升至87.3%。所有评估场景下的精确间隙覆盖率均高于90%的目标值，处于93.3%~96.7%区间。

title: Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid: Bipedal Locomotion with Linear-Quadratic Control and Learned Cost Functions
title_zh: 实现Poppy人形机器人闭环控制：基于线性二次型控制与学习代价函数的双足运动技术
authors: Xulin Chen, Borui He, Ruipeng Liu, Naveed Tahir, Zhenyu Gan 等 (6 人)
abstract: The Poppy Humanoid is an open-source, low-cost robot suitable for research and education in artificial intelligence. However, we are unaware of any published methodology that achieves reliable, unassisted bipedal locomotion on the standard Poppy hardware. This paper contributes a functional closed-loop walking controller for Poppy, based on the linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) framework for trajectory tracking. Starting with data collected from open-loop playback of a nominal walking trajectory, our proposed method learns a quadratic cost function for an LQR controller that substantially improves the reliability of the motion. The closed-loop controller is validated empirically, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in walking performance compared to open-loop trajectory playback.
summary_zh: Poppy人形机器人是一款开源低成本机器人，适用于人工智能领域的研究与教学。但目前尚无公开方法可在标准Poppy硬件上实现可靠的无辅助双足运动。本文提出一套面向Poppy的可用闭环行走控制器，采用面向轨迹跟踪的LQR（线性二次调节器）框架。基于开环回放标称行走轨迹采集的数据集，所提方法可为LQR控制器学习二次代价函数，大幅提升运动可靠性。经实验验证，该闭环控制器的行走性能较开环轨迹回放方案实现了统计意义上的显著提升。

title: Cross-Platform Benchmark of Neural 3D Reconstruction for Autonomous Laboratory Robots
title_zh: 面向自主实验室机器人的神经三维重建跨平台基准测试
authors: Yongho Kim, Mengjiao Han, Victor Mateevitsi, Silvio Rizzi, Michael E. Papka 等 (6 人)
abstract: Autonomous robots performing laboratory tasks depend on 3D reconstruction pipelines that can turn raw camera streams into actionable object representations within the latency budget of a physical control loop. Neural 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated high-quality view synthesis, but their real-time viability across the compute platforms on which laboratory robots actually run remains poorly characterized. In this work, we present a systematic compute-platform benchmark of neural 3D reconstruction methods, evaluating NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting training and rendering on GPU-enabled computing devices ranging from single-board computers to server-class nodes, and place Meta's SAM3D single-image reconstruction on the same axes to quantify its latency and fidelity gap relative to per-scene optimization. Our results show that Gaussian Splatting yields higher rendering quality than NeRF at greater GPU cost, and that onboard compute is insufficient for full per-scene optimization at interactive rates. Our preliminary assessment on SAM3D indicates that it delivers plausible object geometry within seconds, but with detail mismatches that can compromise downstream manipulation. Together, these findings motivate tiered pipelines in which lightweight feed-forward reconstruction sustains the real-time perception-and-tracking loop for laboratory robots, while heavier neural reconstruction is scheduled selectively on suitable compute.
summary_zh: 执行实验室任务的自主机器人依赖三维重建流水线，需要在物理控制回路的时延预算内将原始相机流转化为可用于操作的目标表征。神经三维重建方法已实现高质量视图合成，但在实验室机器人实际搭载的各类计算平台上的实时运行性能仍缺乏系统性评估。本研究开展了针对神经三维重建方法的跨计算平台基准测试，在从单板计算机到服务器级节点的各类GPU设备上评估NeRF（神经辐射场）与3D Gaussian Splatting（3D高斯溅射）的训练与渲染性能，同时对Meta的SAM3D单图像重建方法开展同维度评估，量化其时延与保真度相对逐场景优化方案的差距。结果表明，3D高斯溅射的渲染质量优于NeRF，但GPU计算开销更高，机载计算资源无法支撑全量逐场景优化达到交互级帧率。针对SAM3D的初步评估显示，其可在数秒内生成合理的目标几何结构，但存在细节偏差，可能影响后续操作任务。上述结论支撑分层流水线的设计思路：轻量级前馈重建为实验室机器人提供实时感知跟踪回路，高开销神经重建则在合适的计算资源上按需调度执行。

title: Dispersive Forward Tree Search for Optimal Control: Coverage, Complexity, and Computation
title_zh: 面向最优控制的扩散前向树搜索：覆盖性、复杂度与计算性能
authors: Shashank A. Deshpande, Jonathan P. How
abstract: Steering-based planners require solutions to state-to-state boundary value problems, which can be inaccessible for nonlinear platforms. Forward propagation evades the steering requirement, but the finite-sample behavior of the associated planners remains uncharacterized and their implementations underperform in practice. This paper develops a propagation-based kinodynamic planner with deterministic finite-sample near-optimality guarantees. We work within the large class of differentially flat nonlinear systems and show that a forward tree of locally dispersive control commands contains a near-optimal trajectory at a certified tree size. We provide a general mechanism to construct dispersive command sets for control-affine systems, which are necessary to implement the search algorithm prescribed by the theory. We show that covering the certified trajectory class irrespective of cost provably demands a tree exponentially sized in the problem horizon, and present a cost-conditioned dominance pruning procedure that retains near-optimality at a tree size polynomial in the horizon. We implement the resulting search algorithm, Dispersive Forward Tree search (DFT*), as breadth-first expansion of the forward tree, which maps naturally onto parallel hardware. We design efficient dispersive samplers for the unicycle, the trailer car, and the quadrotor and evaluate challenging planning tasks for these platforms. DFT* delivers consistently competitive and often substantially better solution quality than state-of-the-art kinodynamic planners at comparable solution times on embedded-tier processors, accelerating further as parallel compute is scaled. We also implement DFT* in a receding-horizon loop to demonstrate real-time planning in dynamic environments at embedded-tier compute budgets.
summary_zh: 基于引导的规划器需要求解状态到状态的边值问题，这类问题在非线性平台上往往难以求解。前向传播可规避引导需求，但现有相关规划器的有限样本特性尚未得到表征，实际部署性能不佳。本文提出一款基于传播的动力学规划器，具备确定性有限样本近优性保证。针对大范围的微分平滑非线性系统，证明由局部扩散控制指令构成的前向树，在可认证的树规模下即可包含近优轨迹。提出面向控制仿射系统的扩散指令集通用构造机制，支撑理论所定义搜索算法的落地实现。证明在不考虑代价的前提下覆盖全部可认证轨迹类，所需的树规模随问题时域呈指数增长，进而提出代价感知优势剪枝策略，可在保证近优性的前提下将树规模压缩为随时域多项式增长。最终实现的Dispersive Forward Tree search（DFT*，扩散前向树搜索）算法采用广度优先方式扩展前向树，可天然适配并行硬件。针对独轮车、带拖车车辆与四旋翼平台设计了高效的扩散采样器，在上述平台的高难度规划任务上开展测试。结果表明，DFT*在嵌入式级处理器上可与当前最优动力学规划器保持相当的求解速度，且解的质量更优，性能随并行计算资源扩容进一步提升。将DFT*部署在滚动时域回路中，可在嵌入式级计算预算下实现动态环境的实时规划。

title: Constraint-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Static Shape Estimation of Co-Manipulative Continuum Robots
title_zh: 面向协同操作连续体机器人静态形状估计的约束感知物理信息神经网络
authors: Rana Danesh, Pari Qarehdaghi, Farrokh Janabi-Sharifi
abstract: Static shape estimation of co-manipulative continuum robots (CCRs) is challenging because the continuum arms and manipulated flexible object form a closed chain that must satisfy both static equilibrium and geometric loop-closure constraints. This paper presents a constraint-aware physics-informed neural network (PINN) for static shape estimation of a tendon-driven CCR modeled using the geometric variable strain formulation. The proposed method incorporates a projected static equilibrium residual and a configuration-level geometric residual to enforce the governing mechanics and closed-chain geometry. In simulation, the PINN is compared with a purely data-driven artificial neural network (ANN) under limited and noisy training data. With 140 samples and 50% label noise, the PINN reduces the relative configuration error, equilibrium residual, and closed-chain residual by 67.88%, 67.35%, and 88.06%, respectively. Using the full dataset, the PINN achieves 0.1597% relative configuration error with an inference time of 0.1773 ms, compared with 17.97 s for an iterative nonlinear solver. Experimental fine-tuning reduces the marker RMSE from 2.657 mm to 0.497 mm and increases R2 from -0.788 to 0.937. These results demonstrate accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient static shape estimation of closed-chain CCRs.
summary_zh: 协同操作连续体机器人（CCR）的静态形状估计任务极具挑战性：连续体机械臂与被操作的柔性物体构成闭环链，需同时满足静力学平衡与几何闭环约束。本文提出约束感知物理信息神经网络（PINN），面向采用几何变应变公式建模的腱驱动CCR实现静态形状估计。所提方法引入投影静力学平衡残差与构型级几何残差，强制满足控制力学规则与闭环链几何约束。仿真场景下，在有限带噪训练数据设置下将该PINN与纯数据驱动人工神经网络（ANN）对比：在140个样本、50%标签噪声的设置下，PINN将相对构型误差、平衡残差与闭环链残差分别降低67.88%、67.35%与88.06%。使用全数据集训练时，PINN的相对构型误差达0.1597%，推理耗时仅0.1773ms，而迭代非线性求解器的耗时为17.97s。经实验微调后，标记点RMSE从2.657mm降至0.497mm，R2值从-0.788提升至0.937。结果表明该方法可实现闭环链CCR的高精度、物理自洽且高效的静态形状估计。

title: WALL-SS: Scaling Long-horizon World Models via Next-Scale Autoregression
title_zh: WALL-SS：通过尺度自回归机制实现长周期世界模型规模化
authors: Maeve Zhang, Rain Sun, Xiang Wang, Cyril Zhang, Shalfun Li 等 (25 人)
abstract: Generative world models provide robots with predictive models of how the world evolves under interaction, with growing potential for simulation, planning, policy evaluation, and robot learning. Beyond clip-level future prediction, a unified generative formulation should relate actions to consequences, support flexible horizons and continuous interaction, and enable reward-driven optimization. We introduce WALL-SS, a world model that generates visual futures through Scale-wise autoregressive Scaling, enabling action-controllable and long-horizon robotic simulation. WALL-SS represents embodied trajectories as causal sequences of temporally interleaved observations and actions, making action-dependent state transitions explicit while naturally supporting variable-length generation, streaming extension through reusable causal states, and direct optimization through sequence probabilities. To make this formulation effective over long horizons, we generate each future observation in a coarse-to-fine manner and develop three complementary components within the same hierarchy. Action-conditioned next-scale prediction injects scale-aligned action representations to improve action-future coupling and model both successful and failed behaviors. Scale-compressed long-horizon memory retains recent interactions at fine resolution while compressing distant observations and actions, with scale-wise dream forcing enhancing robustness to self-generated context. Finally, on-policy alignment optimizes autoregressive visual dynamics with action-following and long-term consistency rewards while preserving the pretrained visual distribution. Experiments show that WALL-SS improves action following and trajectory accuracy, supports coherent minute-long streaming rollout under bounded memory, and consistently benefits from on-policy alignment in reducing action drift and long-horizon inconsistency.
